chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to me narrated, who said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Ali al-Washa, from Ahmad ibn 'Aidh, from Abi Khadijah, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Two women cannot sleep together under a single blanket unless there is a partition between them. If they do so, they should be stopped. If they do not listen after being stopped, each of them shall be lashed with a hadd punishment. If they are found again in the blanket, they shall be lashed again. If they are found a third time, they shall be executed.
ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for two women sleeping together without a partition according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq details the graduated judicial punishment for female same-sex relations (Liwat al-Nisa), emphasizing the necessity of a physical barrier (hajib) to prevent intimacy. It outlines a progressive legal framework where initial admonition leads to flogging (hadd) upon persistence, culminating in execution (qatla (execution) for a third recurrence, reflecting the severity attributed to this act in Shia jurisprudence.
